summary.text: Greg Ballard is the Lincoln Party candidate for Secretary of State. A former Republican mayor of Indianapolis (2008-2016) and retired Marine Corps lieutenant colonel, he started the new party to run, and says he is courting independent voters.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Indiana University and a master's degree in military science from Marine Corps University; served 23 years in the Marine Corps, retiring as a lieutenant colonel, including in the Persian Gulf War.
